0022600123.text: The Bucks (0-3) are 5th in the Central, 2.5 games back, and 14th in the East, and they have lost three straight, as they host the Pacers (1-1), who are 3rd in the Central, 1 game back, and 9th in the East. The teams have not met yet this season, and Milwaukee won all four games against Indiana in 2025-26, most recently a 134-123 win in Milwaukee on March 15, 2026. Indiana will be without Ben Sheppard (knee), Johnny Furphy (knee, surgery), and T.J. McConnell (hamstring), who are all listed as out.
